items.rationale: Described as attendance and survey on site; 7.1.7(e)/(f) investigation and first call-out charge, though it may be seen as overlapping with the pinpointing line.
Investigation needed to locate the source, 7.1.7(e); ordinary market price.

items.description: Moisture measurement kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Measurement to establish extent of moisture in the affected parts, 7.1.7(e).
Labour at customary rates under 7.1.7(g); 14 hrs is high for the job but about 85-90 EUR/hr gross is payable if accepted.
The call-out fee is stated to be attendance/survey and the van is billed separately; under 7.1.7(f) this is either the one travel charge or a second one after pos. 1.

items.description: Freeing the pipe run beneath sink
items.rationale: Exposing the affected component is necessary repair work, 7.1.7(a).

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Dismantling and disposal of affected components, 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1; small line.

items.description: Leak repair, copper section with standard insulation
items.rationale: Fracture damage to supply pipe inside the building, 2.4.3; necessary repair at standard specification.
Roof space was not affected by a ground-floor kitchen leak; excluded under 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b).
Equipment hire for drying the affected room, 7.1.7(b)/(e); may overlap with the room drying line under 7.1.8(c).

items.description: Room drying kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Drying of parts with established moisture, 7.1.7(b).
Insulation is already included in pos. 8, so this is a duplicate under 7.1.8(c), billed by the drying firm and not attributable to its work (7.1.8(e)).

items.description: Final site cleaning of the covered work area
items.rationale: Removal of residues generated by the repair is preserved by 7.1.8(a)/5.2.1, but it could be treated as general cleanliness.
First and only travel charge on this contractor's invoice, 7.1.7(f).
Removal of a replaced furnishing item from the dwelling, 7.1.7(h).

items.description: Transport and disposal of damaged table
items.rationale: Transport away of the damaged item, 7.1.7(h); only one table, so the quantity of 2 is questionable.
New-for-old option is on the schedule, so no age deduction under 7.1.1(d); capped at the same model: 440 EUR net x 1.19 = 523.60 EUR gross.
Delivery of the replacement item, 7.1.7(h).

items.description: Assembly and cleaning of installation area
items.rationale: Setting up the replacement and cleaning the position where the item stood, 7.1.7(h).
First travel charge on this invoice, 7.1.7(f), though it partly overlaps with the delivery and transport lines.
Second travel charge on the same invoice; only the first is indemnified under 7.1.7(f).

items.description: Inspection of garden furniture for moisture
items.rationale: Inspection of property that is not among the affected parts and is kept outside the dwelling; excluded under 7.1.8(f).
